Separately, the server defines `ZAddGuestsInputSchema` in `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.schema.ts` as an object `{ bookingId: z.number(), guests: z.array(z.string().email()) }` with no uniqueness check. This is a real, diff-grounded drift and creates duplicated validation logic across client/server (future changes must be applied twice), but it doesn’t by itself prove broken behavior from this diff (the server handler also does additional filtering in `addGuests.handler.ts`).
